text:
marta: FYI nightly-hetero job keeps failing during model warmup on L40 nodes. Started ~02:10 UTC. Failing on the quant-inference warmup step, looks like a device/kernel issue. Can someone triage?

marta: quick paste from the agent log:```
/opt/runtime/lib/libcuda.so: cuModuleGetFunction failed: invalid device function
warming kvcache for shard 3
NVML: GPU 0 Xid 31: GPU access fault, reason unknown
stack: 0x7f... 0x400... 0x8c...
```

marta: image used: registry.redwood/quant-infer:cu118-20260315, node driver reports: nvidia-smi 520.61.05.

ci-bot: Job nightly-hetero #4521 failed: https://ci.redwood.dev/4521 — logs archived. :robot_face:

jonathan: @marta can you paste the exact docker digest or image id? want to confirm toolkit inside image vs kernel driver. also any dmesg lines around the time?

marta: image digest sha256:af3c9e...; short kernel dmesg around failure: "NVRM: GPU at 00000000:3B:00.0: Xid (PCI:0000:3B:00): 31, PID 8421: GPU access fault"

devon: suspects mismatch between cu118 user-space kernels and 520 driver on L40. Could also be kvcache triggering JIT path that hits an unsupported op. Can we rerun a canary with warmup threads=1 and KVCACHE_PREALLOC=1 to rule out concurrency + kvcache allocation race?

marta: filing a quick rerun request now. command I ran locally for repro:```
./scripts/ci-trigger.sh --job nightly-hetero --image registry.redwood/quant-infer:cu118-20260315 --env "WARMUP_THREADS=1 KVCACHE_PREALLOC=1"
```

sam: fyi on previous incidents Xid 31 + invalid device function often correlated with PTX jit on newer toolkit vs older driver. If rerun passes with prealloc it points to allocator/race. If it still fails, try an image built with cu117 or a node with 515 driver.

sre-oncall: requeued a canary run with WARMUP_THREADS=1 and KVCACHE_PREALLOC=1 -> run id ci-rerun/1769870102. ETA ~5m. I'll also pin it to a heterogeneous node set that has driver 520.61.05 to match failure. :white_check_mark:

ci-bot: Rerun scheduled by @sre-oncall: https://ci.redwood.dev/1769870102 — logs will stream here when started.

jonathan: if the canary succeeds, next step is a bisect across image build dates to find the change in the quant kernels or build flags. I can cut a quick older image (cu117) and kick a targeted run.

kevin: another quick check: can we capture nvprof / CUPTI warmup trace on the failing node? may show which kernel symbol is missing (invalid device function). if it's a PTX fallback, we'll see the ptx->cubin path and missing symbol.

marta: noted, I'll attach nvprof trace if rerun fails. for now monitoring ci-rerun/1769870102. thx for the quick turnaround :eyes:

sre-oncall: update: canary started on heterogeneous L40 set, warmup logs streaming. will ping results. :satellite:

marta: ping — if this rerun reproduces, please escalate to eng-runtime and we should start a bisect plan. if it doesn't, I'll keep an eye and try the cu117 image test next. :thumbsup:
